text: I brought you a sourdough loaf. Baked it yesterday. It flew here on my lap.
script: [dry, proud] I brought you a sourdough loaf. Baked it yesterday. [deadpan] It flew here on my lap.

text: Tom, you're skin and bones. Sit. The crisp needs ten minutes on the counter.
script: [warm, fussing] Tom, you're skin and bones. [brisk, firm] Sit. The crisp needs ten minutes on the counter.
[flat, patient] Deedee. They're on your head.

text: Deedee! A mud blob is taking your PIE!
script: [alarmed, breathless] Deedee! [shrill, urgent] A mud blob is taking your PIE!

text: I'd come, but the stomach. Bring me back that fish.
script: [gruff, pained] I'd come, but... the stomach. [brighter, gruff] Bring me back that fish.

text: Also, your starter was bubbling out of the jar, so I baked a boule with it. Don't be mad.
script: [easy, sheepish] Also, your starter was bubbling out of the jar, so I baked a boule with it. [quick, coaxing] Don't be mad.

text: MY FOOT! WHO TOUCHED MY FOOT?!
script: [yelping, outraged] MY FOOT! [furious, bellowing] WHO TOUCHED MY FOOT?!

text: Grrrumble. You're standing in my puddle.
script: [low, gravelly] Grrrumble. [cranky, offended] You're standing in my puddle.

text: I've been doing push-ups in the pond.
script: [gravelly, boastful] I've been doing push-ups in the pond.
